items.title: Qualcomm vs. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: The article compares Qualcomm and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing as semiconductor investment options for 2026. TSM demonstrates superior growth (24% YoY average) and profitability (45.1% net margin) driven by AI demand, while Qualcomm trades at a lower valuation (P/E 18.2x vs 28.0x) but faces margin pressures from rising manufacturing costs. Growth-oriented investors may prefer TSM, while cost-conscious investors might favor Qualcomm.

items.title: TSMC (TSM) is a Great Momentum Stock: Should You Buy?
items.summary: TSMC (TSM) receives a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating with a Momentum Style Score of B. The semiconductor company shows strong price performance, up 3.67% weekly and 63.61% annually, outpacing the S&P 500. Recent earnings estimate revisions have moved upward, with consensus estimates increasing from $16.45 to $16.56 over the past 60 days, supporting its positive momentum outlook.
